messages:
Emma: Quick sync — AsterHealth POC confirmed SSO (SAML) + SCIM + hierarchical RBAC. They want compatibility notes + a Dedicated vs Hosted rough cost before EOD Friday. Can we triage?
Rafael: I can take the SAML/ACS/entityID verification. They use Azure AD and will send IdP metadata. Do we need to support IdP-initiated login for the POC?
Marta: For RBAC mapping I need to know if they expect group nesting support and SCIM group push. We map groups -> roles but nested groups require expansion client-side.
Raj: Security questionnaire flagged two enterprise items: customer-managed KMS for at-rest encryption and 1yr audit log retention. Those push them toward Private/Private+KMS or Dedicated with managed KMS options.
Emma: Also they asked about domain controls — delegated tenant domains and proofing. What's the canonical options we present?
Rafael: We support DNS TXT verification and email ownership for domain claim. For delegated domains we can do a DNS TXT + admin approval flow. Note: if they want automatic provisioning of tenants we require SCIM group claims to include `externalId` mapping.
Marta: SCIM details: need to confirm whether they want delta-only or full-bulk sync. For delta we support /Users?startIndex= and incremental via `lastModified` filter. If they push groups, include `members` arrays. Example SCIM PATCH we typically give them: ```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "replace",
      "path": "emails[type eq \"work\"].value",
      "value": "jdoe@example.com"
    }
  ]
}
```
Rafael: For SAML, ask them to include: IdP metadata XML, ACS URL they expect us to call (SP-initiated), entityID, and attribute statements for groups (e.g., `memberOf`). If they need SLO we can add it but it adds setup time.
Raj: Pricing notes up-front: they gave traffic estimate ~20k MAU, ~200 peak QPS, heavy embeddings. Rough Dedicated starter: 2 x mid-GPU reserved + burst -> ballpark $18k–$28k/mo depending on model profile and quantization. Hosted consumption for embeddings will be add-on; we should ask for expected tokens/month or embeddings/hour to firm numbers.
Emma: Action items: Rafael -> validate SAML metadata and ACS (ETA: tomorrow). Marta -> produce RBAC mapping doc and sample SCIM schema + group expansion guidance (ETA: end of day tomorrow). Raj -> draft Dedicated vs Hosted cost ranges and list gating assumptions (tokens, qps, models) (ETA: EOD Thursday). Emma -> schedule 30m POC kickoff with their infra lead and send security questionnaire.
SecurityBot: Compliance note — SOC2 & ISO27001 package available; DPA & Data Processing Addendum link: https://redwood.example/legal/dpa. KMS options: managed, customer-managed via KMS/HSM (Private).
Rafael: Two technical flags to confirm with Aster infra: 1) Will they push groups via SCIM or only sync users? 2) Do they require IdP-initiated flows & SLO?
Marta: Also need a sample Okta attribute mapping they use for nested groups. If they send a sample token payload we can map to our `roleMapping` config.
Emma: I'll draft the email to collect IdP metadata, SCIM base URL + token, sample group payload, and the questionnaire answers. Scheduling: propose Wed 10am PT for a working call.
Raj: I'll include an example quote table with low/med/high usage decks and assumptions (model, average tokens per request, embedding calls per user).
Emma: Perfect — once we have metadata we can run a quick validation and surface any integration blockers before the call. :thumbsup:
Marta: :thumbsup:
